notes.title: The Capture Games! Now available on Steam!
notes.notes:
Cheers!

With the launch of The Capture Games now on Steam, you too can enjoy the roguelike survival gameplay anywhere you enjoy Steam. While I don't have a SteamDeck to officially test it on, it's my understanding that RPG Maker games tend to run well on them regardless!

A quick note for those who have multiple GPUs: Windows likes to default RPG Maker games to the crappiest one, usually the integrated one, which can cause this game to have some performance issued. Be sure to go to your settings and force Windows to use your good GPU for this. (Thanks Windows! \s )

If it all seems a bit overwhelming or you don't feel like discovering everything for yourself, check out this handy [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3035282254]Quick Start Guide[/url] over in the Community section for some tips!

Making this game was a lot of fun, and I'm glad I had the opportunity to share with you something that's a little bit different than what I normally make.

Oh, and for those Hanaja's Body fans, don't worry, I'm working on the sequel to that next! ːsteamthumbsupː
